name: Norman Y. Mineta San José International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways, 12L/30R and 12R/30L, each 11,000 ft x 150 ft (about 3,353 m x 46 m)

curfew.v: noise-based curfew (since October 2003): Stage II aircraft may not operate 23:00-07:00 local; quieter Stage III aircraft at or below 89.0 EPNdB and some grandfathered Stage 3 jets on the airport's Schedule of Authorized Aircraft are treated separately for 23:30-06:30; check the aircraft against the schedule; exemptions for delays beyond the operator's control, emergencies and government aircraft; fine USD 2,500 per violation
curfew.quote: FAR 36 Stage II aircraft may not operate between the hours of 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

noise.v: curfew violations are fined USD 2,500 per occurrence by administrative citation; engine run-ups are normally not allowed during curfew hours

customs.v: CBP clears arriving aircraft 7 days a week, 09:00-18:00 (wheels down), plane-side at the FBO; permission to land must be requested at least 24 hours before arrival
customs.quote: are available 7 days per week, 0900-1800 (wheels down)

ppr.v: for international arrivals, CBP permission to land at least 24 hours before arrival
ppr.quote: Pilots must secure permission to land by contacting CBP at least 24 hours prior to arrival time at KSJC.

handling.v: two FBOs: Atlantic Aviation and Signature Flight Support

hours.v: control tower 06:00-24:00 local; the source does not state the airport's own opening hours

missing: customs (newer CBP fact sheet of 9 Feb 2026 not opened)
notes: Runway sizes are from the FAA airport diagram AL-693 (cycle 30 Oct-27 Nov 2025; the newest cycle was not opened); metres are my conversion (1 ft = 0.3048 m). The curfew page wording read through the fetch tool says quieter Stage III aircraft (<= 89.0 EPNdB) 'can operate between the hours of 11:30 p.m. to 6:30 a.m.'; how this applies to each business jet depends on the Schedule of Authorized Aircraft (rev. Nov 2022, https://www.flysanjose.com/sites/default/files/CMarquez/SJC%20Authorized%20Aircraft%20Schedule%202022.pdf), which could not be opened. The portal window 23:00-07:00 is the Stage II rule and is the safe reading. CBP customs hours are from the 25 Jul 2024 sheet; a newer sheet (9 Feb 2026, https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-02/KSJC%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260209.pdf) exists but could not be opened, so customs hours may have changed; the 2024 sheet does not state the time zone on the hours line. FAA Chart Supplement SW (3 Sep 2026, https://aeronav.faa.gov/Upload_313-d/supplements/CS_SW_20260903.pdf) could not be opened. 1 Nov 2026: added the FBO list from the airport's Fixed Base Operators page (no date; quote joins the two list items). Not opened again: the CBP sheet of 9 Feb 2026 and the Schedule of Authorized Aircraft (no route to them via search). KSJC is not on the FAA US AIP California AD 2 page. | 3 Nov 2026: opened the Schedule of Authorized Aircraft (issued 9 Nov 2022, https://www.flysanjose.com/sites/default/files/CMarquez/SJC%20Authorized%20Aircraft%20Schedule%202022.pdf). It lists types 'authorized to operate during the Curfew Hours from 2330 to 0630 local time'; some models need an FAA noise certificate showing 89.0 EPNdB or less for the specific aircraft. Listed types include Gulfstream G-IV, G-V, G-650, Falcon 7X, 900, 2000 and Citations; the Global and Challenger row was not clear in the extracted text, so check the original before a night trip. The curfew rule is kept unchanged. CBP sheets of 9 Feb 2026 and 6 Jan 2025 and the KSJC detail page were refused; the CBP port page 2834 shows office hours 09:00-17:00 Pacific, Mon-Sun, which are not general aviation clearance hours, so the customs rule from the 2024 sheet stays and may be out of date. 5 Nov 2026: Refused: https://www.faa.gov/flight_deck/pilot_info/sjc.pdf (permission not answered); CBP sheet of 9 Feb 2026 still unread. Slots: the FAA lists (Federal Register 9 Oct 2026; Level 3 page of Jan 2023) do not name this airport, but no source says so of it, so nothing is recorded. | 7 Nov 2026: re-read the Curfew page (https://flysanjose.com/curfew, no date; programme revised Oct 2003, schedule last revised Nov 2022): wording unchanged, curfew rule kept. The airport's notice to GA tenants of 14 Oct 2025 says 'Effective May 2026, SJC will implement a landing fee for all aircrafts over 12,500 pounds' at a proposed USD 6.80 per 1,000 lb maximum gross landing weight; it is a proposal with inconsistent dates and is not recorded as a rule. Customs still from the 2024 sheet: the CBP sheet of 9 Feb 2026 (https://www.cbp.gov/sites/default/files/2026-02/KSJC%20GA%20Airport%20Fact%20Sheet%2020260209.pdf) and the CBP KSJC fact sheet details page failed (client error; the proxy also refuses cbp.gov). Fuel, max aircraft and slots still missing; FAA Chart Supplement SW 29 Oct 2026 not opened (permission not answered).
